english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for establishing communication with a person or organization.
Use 聯絡 as the all-purpose choice when establishing or maintaining contact between people or organizations.

examples.english: We will contact the organizer to confirm the registration details.
examples.traditional: 我哋會聯絡主辦單位確認報名資料。

examples.english: We will liaise with the other company to follow up on the collaboration.
examples.traditional: 我哋會聯絡對方公司，跟進合作事宜。
